args: In libdwarf/src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_line_table_reader_common.h, what are the exact semantics of experimental `lc_logicals_table_offset` and `lc_actuals_table_offset`, and what validity/order checks should `_dwarf_read_line_table_header` apply relative to `lc_line_prologue_start`, the parsed instruction start (`lp_begin`/`line_ptr`), and `lc_line_ptr_end`? Please identify any upstream or analogous validation if known.

The reported ASan crash occurs because `_dwarf_internal_srclines` in libdwarf/src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_line.c computes `line_ptr_actuals = lc_line_prologue_start + lc_actuals_table_offset` without bounds checks, then uses it as the logical program end. In the header reader, experimental offsets are read around lines 652-660 and stored immediately; later `lp_begin` is formed from prologue start plus logicals offset around lines 1238-1240, but malformed actuals offsets are unchecked. The requested root fix is to reject checked additions outside the current unit and reject non-ordered boundaries, while preserving valid two-level tables. I am deciding whether validation belongs immediately after offset decoding or after the complete header when the actual instruction start is known.
